Site deploys that upload only the files that changed, CloudFront invalidations that reach every file on large sites, and two fixes for Step Functions `Choice` states. Still built on upstream [v4.17.2](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/releases/tag/v4.17.2).

Thanks to [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya), who sent the pull requests below, most of them carrying fixes from SST's repository. The authors of the SST pull requests they carry, and the people who reported the problems, are named with each one.

### Fixes

- **Static and SSR site deploys upload only the files that changed.** A file whose content, cache-control and content type are the same as in the last deploy is skipped. Before, every file with a cache-control value was uploaded again, which is every file of a `StaticSite` or an SSR site. A file changed by hand in the site's bucket is no longer put back by a deploy that doesn't change it. ([#297](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/297), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya), carrying [anomalyco/sst#7055](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/7055) by [@zemberdotnet](https://github.com/zemberdotnet))
- **A CloudFront invalidation with more than 3000 file paths and a wildcard path clears every file.** The wildcards were written over the first files of the next batch, so those files kept their cached copies and the wildcards were sent twice. ([#293](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/293), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya))
- **`sst.aws.StepFunctions` keeps the states before a `Choice` when the `definition` is a state after it,** such as the last state of a branch. The state machine was built from the branch and left out the `Choice` and every state before it, with no error. ([#301](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/301), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya))
- **The `Choice` docs say to pass a chain's first state to `when` and `otherwise`.** `a.next(b)` returns `b`, so passing it starts the branch at `b` and `a` doesn't run. The docs now show passing `a`. ([#304](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/304), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya); [anomalyco/sst#6037](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/6037), reported by [@straygar](https://github.com/straygar))

### Also

- Four cleanups in the CLI that change nothing users see, each with tests of the code it touches: `slices.Contains` for the Router's route lookup, `maps.Copy` for plain map merges, range-over-int and unused `break`s, and `slices.Backward` for two reverse loops ([#287](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/287), [#290](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/290), [#295](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/295), [#291](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/291), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya), carrying [anomalyco/sst#7008](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/7008), [anomalyco/sst#7005](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/7005), [anomalyco/sst#7009](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/7009) and [anomalyco/sst#7010](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/7010) by [@iliya-vidrush](https://github.com/iliya-vidrush)).

### Install

```bash
npm install sst@npm:@sst-community/sst@4.26.1
```

To switch an existing project:

1. Check that `node --version` shows `v22` or later, wherever you run `sst`, CI included.
2. Set its dependency to `"sst": "npm:@sst-community/sst@4.26.1"` and reinstall.

For a project that isn't JavaScript, install the CLI globally. It still needs Node.js 22 or later, to run `sst.config.ts`:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sst-community/sst/main/install | bash
```
